IN MORE DETAIL

UK on-site support and European engineering coverage

HeyDock has engineers in the UK and Europe and scopes attendance against the customer’s actual location. Availability depends on the city, required skill, site access, work window and travel arrangements. We do not list offices in cities where a physical business location has not been confirmed.

For cross-border work, agree language, time zone, site rules and contracting arrangements before scheduling. Remote assistance may solve part of the requirement, while a local engineer handles the physical tasks. A combined approach is often useful for network smart hands, equipment checks and repeatable deployments.

Global delivery is an expansion objective, not a claim of unrestricted worldwide on-site coverage. Share the location and work order so available options can be confirmed. Multiple sites should be listed separately where skills, access or service expectations differ.
